text: School, training or a move to university or work can bring your teen new pressures. Help them with: a steady routine for sleep, movement and meals; people they trust; and a weekly check-in where they can tell you about their mood without blame.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance.
